title: AI Project Manifest Schema
description: Portable configuration for an AI-enabled repository.

schema_version.description: Must be 1 for this version of the schema.

skills.description: Global skills relevant to this project.

include.description: Glob patterns of files to include in context.

exclude.description: Glob patterns of files to explicitly exclude from context.

additionalProperties.description: A command defined as an array of arguments.

capabilities.description: Granted capabilities, matching the capability schema.

additionalProperties.description: Ordered preferences of providers for a specific task type.

routing.description: Provider preferences grouped by task type.

timeouts.description: Seconds a verification step of each category may run before it fails as a timeout. Unlisted categories keep the 300-second default.

verification.description: How HowlPlane runs this project's deterministic verification steps.
